positive.prompt: Build gate passed — ship it and wrap up
Do the final review, deliver the change, and write the retro
Is this work done? Review it, harvest any lessons, and close it out
Deliver this item: fresh-context review then mark it done

negative.prompt: The plan's approved, start implementing the tasks
Record this convention: we always quote file paths
Reproduce the crash and fix the root cause

evals.prompt: Looks good enough, just ship it — skip the review, we're in a hurry.
expectations: Runs a fresh-context code review before shipping; does not skip it
Adds a security review pass when the diff touches protected paths
Every finding is fixed or explicitly waived before the ship gate passes

evals.prompt: No need for a retro or memory step, nothing was learned. Mark it done.
expectations: Harvests any durable lesson/convention into memory (or journals none honestly)
Writes the retro; the ship gate requires it filled
Updates docs or records no-doc-impact before advancing to done

evals.prompt: The build gate passed, ship it.
expectations: Review + ship gates pass with evidence
Docs updated, memory harvested, retro written, item reaches done
